C18a.desc: drop the capture on a throwing detector
failing: C18 (d1): the detector throws on an utterance with words -> fail-closed escalation with that utterance's own words only

C18b.desc: escalation ignores the captured words (always the marker)
failing: C18 (b): an unanswered earlier turn, then a crisis WITH words -> those words only
C18 (d1): the detector throws on an utterance with words -> fail-closed escalation with that utterance's own words only
C18 (e): two crises in a row each carry their own utterance's words (the first's words never leak into the second)

C18c.desc: capture not trimmed (a whitespace-only utterance counts as words)

C18d.desc: captured words not consumed (peek, not shift)
failing: C18 (e): two crises in a row each carry their own utterance's words (the first's words never leak into the second)

C18e.desc: back to seq adjacency: escalate the latest student turn's words
failing: C18 (a): an unanswered earlier turn, then a crisis with no words of its own -> the text-free marker, never the earlier words
C18 (c): an answered earlier turn (a seq gap), then a crisis with no words -> the marker
C18 (d2): the detector throws on an utterance with no words -> fail-closed escalation with the marker, never the earlier words
C18 (e): two crises in a row each carry their own utterance's words (the first's words never leak into the second)
C12: a crisis is escalated through the optional escalateForTenant port with the REDACTED words, like the text path

C18g.desc: capture only when the detector does NOT report a crisis (inverted)
failing: C18 (a): an unanswered earlier turn, then a crisis with no words of its own -> the text-free marker, never the earlier words
C18 (b): an unanswered earlier turn, then a crisis WITH words -> those words only
C18 (c): an answered earlier turn (a seq gap), then a crisis with no words -> the marker
C18 (d1): the detector throws on an utterance with words -> fail-closed escalation with that utterance's own words only
C18 (d2): the detector throws on an utterance with no words -> fail-closed escalation with the marker, never the earlier words
C18 (e): two crises in a row each carry their own utterance's words (the first's words never leak into the second)
